head: f69f200ec84e7ed3657621f3fb8c922e80ee12a0
title: fix(roman): a used-up coach AI credit pool gets its own copy, not a retry (AUDIT-05-125)
body:
**Tier:** T2 (client-visible error state on the Roman chat; no money movement, no auth, no data access change)
**Why:** AUDIT-05-125 (agent 125). SoT A6.4: "Pool empty -> its own code and copy." The backend already sends 402 `COACH_AI_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED` (B-668-1, in production); the app ignored it.
**T4 trigger scan:** none. No auth, RLS/tenancy, PII, payment, credential or destructive-data path. Reads only the machine `code` of an error body; shows no credit figures to clients.
**T3 trigger scan:** none (no schema, no API contract change, no new dependency, no flag).
**Bounded T1:** n/a.
**Canonical builder:** Claude Opus 5.5 (AUDIT-05-125).
**Acceptance evidence:** `src/__tests__/romanPoolEmpty125.test.tsx` fails on main (402 maps to `generic`; `romanPoolEmpty` does not exist) and passes here; full lint, typecheck and tests run in this PR's CI.

## Fixes
- **U1 (AUDIT-05-125):** a client whose coach's monthly AI credit pool is used up sends Roman a message and sees "That request did not complete. Send it once more, and I will try again." with a Send again button that can never work. Now: the 402 (before the turn is stored) and the same code in the stream error frame map to kind `poolEmpty`; the chat shows "Your coach's AI credits for this month are used up, so Roman cannot answer right now. Your coach is in Messages any time, and your plan and logs work as usual." (client) or the coach-account line (coach), with no Send again button. The composer stays usable, so a crisis message (never pool-gated on the server) still goes through.

## Compatibility
Works against the current production backend (ec12a4b3), which already returns this code. A 402 without the code stays generic.

## Notes
- The coach copy names no purchase step: digital credit packs are not sold in the store builds (iOS gate; Android in m#412). No overlap with any open PR's files.
- Changed lines: about 200 (154 of them the test).
